name: Brand Stories (Hindi)
style: Hinglish in Devanagari: everyday Hindi, English business words kept in English (CEO, startup, revenue, billion). Numbers as digits.
structure: 1 HOOK (<=14 words): the shocking moment/number. Never start with 'आज हम बात करेंगे'.
2 CONTEXT: who was big, who was small
7 PUNCHLINE: one-line lesson that loops back to the hook
sceneMix: Start with collage (goldFrame push) or versus; include exactly one chart with a real number; one kinetic line; end scene last. Never 3 same types in a row.

variety.rule: Every episode picks a NEW combination: look ≠ previous Short, hookType not in last 2, captionStyle+transition not in last 3, opening 3 scene types not in last 5, music not in last 5. Choose by the story's emotion, not at random: rise/success → gold/lightleak; fall/failure → noir or archive + smoke/embers; tech/internet → neon + glitch; history/old India → paper or archive; modern startup → clean.
